product_launches.description: ScyllaDB announced the launch of ScyllaDB X Cloud, a fully managed, elastic database-as-a-service designed for high scalability and cost efficiency. The new product introduces features like just-in-time auto scaling, high storage utilization, and advanced compression, aiming to reduce infrastructure costs and improve performance for data-intensive applications.

overview_description.description: ScyllaDB is the monstrously fast and scalable database for today's terabyte-scale and beyond data intensive applications. ScyllaDB is available as open source and enterprise offerings that can be run anywhere, and ScyllaDB Cloud, a fully-managed Database as a Service (DBaaS) available on AWS and Google Cloud. ScyllaDB supports wide-column NoSQL workloads fully compatible with Apache Cassandra and Amazon DynamoDB. ScyllaDB was founded under the name Cloudius Systems. As Cloudius Systems, the company pioneered the unikernel trend with the development of OSv, designed from the ground up to execute a single application on top of a hypervisor for superior performance and effortless management.

about_short_description.short_description: ScyllaDB produces a NoSQL database compatible with Apache Cassandra and Amazon DynamoDB at 10x the throughput with reliably low latencies.

product.name: ScyllaDB
product.description: A distributed NoSQL database for high-throughput, low-latency applications, compatible with Apache Cassandra through CQL and with DynamoDB through Alternator.

product.name: ScyllaDB Cloud
product.description: A fully managed ScyllaDB database service running on AWS and Google Cloud, with managed operations, elastic scaling, backups, monitoring, and support.

product.name: ScyllaDB Enterprise
product.description: A commercial distribution of ScyllaDB with tested binaries, enterprise features, cluster administration tools, hot fixes, ScyllaDB Manager, and 24/7 technical support.

product.name: ScyllaDB Vector Search
product.description: An integrated vector search capability for storing embeddings and performing approximate nearest-neighbor queries alongside operational data in ScyllaDB.

product.name: ScyllaDB Alternator
product.description: A DynamoDB-compatible API that lets existing DynamoDB applications use ScyllaDB with the same client SDKs, data models, and queries.

product.name: ScyllaDB Operator
product.description: An open-source Kubernetes operator for deploying and managing ScyllaDB clusters, including installation, scaling, upgrades, and operational automation.
